defect: measured-clock to reference-clock ratio is an unstated PLL/board contract
rationale: The measurement logic can only classify fast and slow after knowing the intended ratio between clk_i and clk_ref_i. The RTL provides no PLL configuration or frequency bound, so the two declared periods cannot be judged as the correct relationship.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced clock measurement to independent reference and measured-domain counters with fast/slow indications.

labels.note: Two clocks of 5ns and 10ns left related by default with en_i delayed against both; whether they are synchronous (PLL ratio) or asynchronous is not given.
